“We are in way over our heads!” Senko says. “Don’t you dare give up on me!” her red haired Uzumaki friend responds. They find themselves in a rather dangerous situation. The building is collapsing in around them, their enemies have escaped, and they have a downed ally, while they are also all wounded. “You have to use it Senko!” the Uzumaki screams. “What!? No! I haven’t mastered it yet, what if the blow back~” she begins, but is caught off guard by her friend’s tearful pleas. “Fine! Stand back. I’m about to blow us out of here!!!”

—Tye Tiken

At Worlds End, Ch. 3 excerpt.

An Explosive Personality

The Bakuton Clan is a clan without a clear family name, but one with a fearsome history and purpose. Members of this clan can be found in villages, across the country, and are used to great effect in different military institutions. The Bakuton Family line is one of power, and absolute authority. These shinobi are known to control a battlefield through force alone, and very few can say they would stand a chance against one in a head-to-head match.

Bakuton Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Int

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Chakra Control, and your choice between Ninshou or Martial Arts.

Explosion Release Affinity: You begin with either Earth or Lightning Release Affinity. (Pick one)

Explosive Techniques: The Bakuton Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Bakuton Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Branch Family: The Bakuton are split between two different branches, the [Artistic Branch] and the [Reckless Branch]. The artistic branch are artisans who also happen to be demolitionist. The reckless branch acts as demolitionists who happen to be brawlers. Select which branch your character is a part of. This determines some clan features or which Hijutsu you gain/have access to. This cannot be changed later.

Bakuton Features

Artistic Cataclysm

1st Level Clan Feature, [Artistic Branch]

You are born with 3 mouths. The one on your face, and one on each hand. These additional mouths have the ability to infuse explosive chakra into any substance they can lick or chew. This is represented by a unique for of combat that only you can reasonably utilize, your Artistic Cataclysm Chakra stance.

As a bonus action, you can enter this Artistic Cataclysm chakra stance. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits;

Clay constructs you command all act as part of the same Bonus action spent to command them. You can command each Clay Construct separately.

When you take the attack action or cast a Bakuton Clan Hijutsu that requires an attack, you can choose to replace any number of attacks made with the action with a Clay Bombings attack. Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack feature, when you take the Attack action while in this stance, you can attack twice with your Clay Bombing attack, instead of once

Clay Bombings. Make a ranged jutsu attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet of you, dealing 1d12 force damage on a hit. If you roll a 12 on the damage die of this attack, you can add 1 additional damage die to the result as the attack is far more explosive.

Beginning at 7th level, increase the damage of this attack to 2d12 and Barriers, structures and constructs treat this attacks damage as if they were vulnerable to it.

Ballistic Knuckle

1st Level Clan Feature, [Reckless Branch]

When you would get into scraps as a child the one thing everyone could agree on, was that you had hands…explosive ones. This is represented by a unique form of combat that only you could reasonably utilize, your Ballistic Knuckle Taijutsu stance.

As a Bonus action, you can enter this Ballistic Knuckle Taijutsu stance. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits:

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes 2d8, damage type becomes force, and no longer adds your ability modifier to the damage dealt.

Your unarmed attacks gain the Deadly 1 weapon property. This increases to Deadly 2 at 7th level and Deadly 3 at 15th level.

You gain resistance to damage you would take as a result of your own clan features.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack feature, you can attack twice while in this stance, instead of once.

Priming Cataclysm

3rd Level Clan Feature

You don’t set traps. You schedule surprises. You learn to manufacture compact chakra charges that detonate at your command. Once per turn, when you deal [Unarmed Damage], damage as a result of Clay Bombings, or damage as a result of a Bakuton clan Hijutsu you can Prime all damaged creatures. Alternatively, as a bonus action you can Prime an object or structure you touch. Primes last for 1 minute or until detonated. You can maintain up to 4 Primes at any given moment, and a creature can be Primed more than once.

While Primes are active, you can spend your Action, Bonus Action or Reaction, on your turn to detonate all Primes. When a Prime detonates an explosion filling a 5-foot radius centered on the affected creature or object goes off. Primes on a structure explode with a radius originating from the place the Prime was set. This radius is increased in size for every Prime a creature, object or structure has by +5 feet.

All creatures in the area of an explosion, must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, taking 2d6 force damage for every Prime detonate on that same target or half as much on a success. If a creature would be caught in multiple overlapping explosions, it is only affected by one of them, which you choose.

Your Prime detonations scale with you. At 7th level, the number of Primes you can have active at once increases by +1. At 11th level, increase the damage of your Primes to 3d6. At 15th level the number of Primes you can have active at once increases by +1.

Artistic Payloads

7th Level Clan Feature, [Artistic Branch]

Your charges are like a composition of a beautiful symphony, an amazing sculpture, a once in a lifetime painting. Detonating them bring forth the beauty within that others just don’t understand. You gain the second nature release you didn’t select from Explosion Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Lightning or Earth Release keywords, you can change the damage type to force.

You learn three Payloads, and choose which two you have prepared after each rest. Unless a payload says otherwise, affected creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. You learn 2 more Payloads at 11th level and can prepare three to use after each rest.

When you detonate Primed creatures, objects and structures you can select one Payload infusing their effect into the detonation itself. Only one detonation will have the Payload effect.

A1 Scatter burst

Scatter Burst. The detonation forces all creatures who failed their saving throw to be thrown 30-feet into a direction of your choice excluding airborne and falling prone. You can choose which direction each creature is thrown individually.

A2 Smoke Petals

Smoke Petals. The detonation creates a 20-foot radius of smoke that heavily obscures vision. This smoke lasts until the end of your next turn. Creatures who fail their saving throw gain 1 rank of Concussed and Dazzled.

A3 Seismic Quake

Seismic Quake. The detonation shatters the ground making the affected area difficult terrain. Creatures that fail their saving throw are Slowed until the end of their next turn from the shock of the explosion

A4 Fractal Adhesive

Fractal Adhesive. The detonation creates a splash of sticky mud like adhesive that binds to everything. Creatures that fail their saving throw are Restrained in place by the adhesive until the end of their next turn.

A5 Cluster Gallery

Cluster Gallery. The detonation creates 4 mini charges which each land on a point of your choice within 20-feet of the triggering explosions affected area. Each mini charge then explodes in a 5-foot radius forcing creatures in each new zone to make their saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Concussed and being knocked Prone on a failed save. A creature can be affected by up to 2 mini charge at a time, but only make a saving throw once to determine if you suffer the mini charges effect twice.

Reckless Payloads

7th Level Clan Feature, [Reckless Branch]

You detonate your charges while in point blank range. You gain the second nature release you didn’t select from Explosion Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Lightning or Earth Release keywords, you can change the damage type to force.

You learn three Payloads, and choose which two you have prepared after each rest. Unless a payload says otherwise, affected creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. You learn 2 more Payloads at 11th level and can prepare three to use after each rest. You are immune to your own Payload effects.

You can detonate a single Primed creature instead of all creatures by dealing [Unarmed Damage] to them and these payloads can change the shape of the affected area.

When you detonate Primed creatures, objects and structures you can select one Payload infusing their effect into the detonation itself. Only one detonation will have the Payload effect.

B1 Knuckle Burst

Knuckle Burst. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 30-foot cone originating from you. Creatures who fail their saving throw gain 1 rank of Shaken.

B2 Armor Crack

Armor Crack. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 60-foot line originating from you. Creatures who fail their saving throw reduce their AC by 2 until the end of your next turn.

B3 Flash bang

Flash Bang. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 20-foot cube originating from you. Creatures who fail their saving throw are Blinded until the end of their next turn.

B4 Ear Ringer

Ear Ringer. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 30-foot cone originating from you. Creature who fail their saving throw are Deafened and gain 2 ranks of Concussed.

B5 Barrier Buster

Barrier Buster. If the detonation is triggered by [Unarmed Damage], its affected area becomes a 60-foot-long line originating from you. Creature who fail their saving throw have effects they are benefiting from as a result of a jutsu with the Barrier keyword dispelled, before damage is calculated.

Controlled Demolition

11th Level Clan Feature

You’ve blown up enough things to know how to not blow up everything. While you are not in combat, you can spend 10 minutes placing and tuning a Prime to Breach a surface or structure within your reach.

Breach. You blow a 5-foot-wide hole through up to 5 feet of material, even if chakra reinforced.

| #### Cataclysm Knuckle / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / Blast Zone. You are immune to the harmful effects of your Primes, Bakuton Hijutsu and Clan features. / Black Powder Pressure. When you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a creature and Prime them, they are marked twice instead of once. / Detonation Momentum. You gain a bonus to your attack critical threat range when attacking a Primed creature. This bonus is equal to the number of Primes they have active on them. |

Additionally, you can ensure negotiations, while hostile, go your way. As part of making an Intimidation or Persuasion check against a non-combat ready creature, you can pretend to set a visible charge, Priming yourself or another creature, object or structure within 10-feet of you. On a successful check, the target becomes extremely compliant for the next minute, answering the next question as truthfully as possible, delaying sounding alarms and even escorting you somewhere to avoid blowing up with you. A creature will attempt to defend themselves if they take damage or realize the Prime was fake. To realize a Prime is fake a creature makes a perception check vs your highest jutsu save DC.

Explosive Art!

15th Level Clan Feature, [Artistic Branch]

You become a walking magazine of explosive potential. As a Bonus action, you can enter the Grand Detonator state for the next minute. Once you enter this state, you cannot enter it again until you complete a long rest.

| #### Grand Detonator / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / Expanded Limit. You can have up to 8 Primes active at once. / If Looks Could Kill. Once per turn, you can detonate a single Primed creature without spending an action on your turn. / Lethal Charge. You can infuse up to 3 different Payloads into a detonation. / Terrain Buster. All detonations can create difficult terrain in the affected area. |

Bombfist Brawler

15th Level Clan Feature, [Reckless Branch]

You become a walking warhead capable of releasing explosive bombs with each strike. As a Bonus action, you can enter the Cataclysm Knuckle state for the next minute. Once you enter this state, you cannot enter it again until you complete a long rest.
